run_get_thermo: read a thermo log file and return simulation time and total energy arrays
run_get_nve_md_data: load MD22 or TM23 dataset structures with their target temperatures from a dataset root
create_NVEMDRunner: create an NVE molecular dynamics runner with a calculator, timestep, steps, and save frequency
run_NVEMDRunner_calculate: run geometry relaxation then NVE molecular dynamics simulation on a single atomic structure
run_NVEMDRunner_write_results: read and validate thermo log results after an NVE molecular dynamics simulation completes
